start: A person with an Android phone taps mettleup's app link app.mettleup.fit/app

steps.action: Tap the link
user_sees: Google Play's MettleUp listing, straight away (no page in between)
must_not: A page that asks them to tap again
Another app's listing

start: The same link tapped on an iPhone; APP_STORE_URL is empty (today)

steps.action: Tap the link
user_sees: 'Get the MettleUp app'
'The iPhone app is coming soon'
'What you can do now'
'Have an Android phone too? Open this link on it to get the app.'
must_not: A jump to Google Play on an iPhone
A broken App Store link

start: The same link opened on a computer

steps.action: Open the link
user_sees: 'Get the MettleUp app on your phone'
'Scan this QR code with your phone’s camera'
'app.mettleup.fit/app'
'GET IT ON Google Play' and 'App Store Coming soon'
must_not: A store redirect on a computer

start: The link is pasted into WhatsApp or Facebook (link preview fetcher)

steps.action: Look at the preview
user_sees: A preview titled 'Get the MettleUp app' with its picture
must_not: A preview of the Google Play page or no preview at all

start: APP_STORE_URL was set with a typo (not an apps.apple.com /app/ address)

steps.action: Tap the link on an iPhone
user_sees: The 'coming soon' page as if no address were set
must_not: A redirect to the wrong address

start: The iPhone app comes out and APP_STORE_URL is set; later it is emptied again

steps.action: Tap the link on an iPhone after it is set
user_sees: The App Store page straight away
must_not: The 'coming soon' page served from a cache

steps.action: Tap again after it is emptied
user_sees: The 'coming soon' page again
must_not: A cached redirect to the App Store

start: Anyone taps the link

steps.action: Tap the link
user_sees: The kind of device is judged from the browser's own description only; nothing is kept
must_not: A cookie or anything personal put in the address

start: A member's Android phone has no Google Play and opens app.mettleup.fit/app/apk

steps.action: Open the link
user_sees: The newest MettleUp APK starts downloading (mettleup-v<x>.apk of the latest release)
must_not: An older version for more than 10 minutes after a release
A file of another app

start: GitHub could not be reached when the newest release was looked up

steps.action: Open /app/apk
user_sees: GitHub's latest release page, where the APK can be picked by hand
must_not: An error page with nothing to tap

start: A new release was published 3 minutes ago

steps.action: Open /app/apk
user_sees: The previous APK for up to 10 minutes, then the new one
must_not: A link to an APK file that does not exist

start: The owner puts the /app link on a poster or in a message to members

steps.action: Members tap or scan it on their phones
user_sees: Android: Google Play; iPhone: the 'coming soon' page; computer: the QR page
must_not: A gym-specific page (this link carries no gym)

start: The owner opens /app on an iPhone

steps.action: Tap the link
user_sees: 'The iPhone app is coming soon'
must_not: The owner thinking the app is installed

start: The get-app page could not be loaded from the site files

steps.action: Open /app on a computer
user_sees: Sent straight to Google Play instead of the QR page
must_not: An error page

start: The owner puts the /app link on a poster or in a message to members

steps.action: Members tap or scan it on their phones
user_sees: Android: Google Play; iPhone: the 'coming soon' page; computer: the QR page
must_not: A gym-specific page (this link carries no gym)

steps.action: Turn the internet off at step 1 of "Smart app link", carry on, then turn it back on.
user_sees: A plain word that the work is saved on the device or could not be saved, and it is sent once when the internet is back
must_not: A lost saved data, a double saved data after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: No internet at the tap: the store or page does not open

steps.action: Do "Smart app link" on a phone screen 360 px wide.

must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

steps.action: Members tap or scan it on their phones

note: The QR page on a computer and the coming-soon page on a phone
